attr.title: Balloon Challenge
attr.desc: Balloon Challenge is William Soleau's 1993 DOS strategy game: launch your 25 balloons into a sky full of airplanes, dark clouds, directional clouds, hurricanes and bonus clouds, and get them higher than the computer's.
attr.inst: Ready to run. The shareware game files are included. Owners of the registered version can copy their files over the included ones in ports/balloonchallenge/gamedata/ to play against a second human player.
